item.title: 1.0.0-beta.4
item.description:
## What's Changed ## Clipboard History & Search
- New Clipboard tab: revisit copied text, links, images. - Search history with Exact, Mixed, Regex, Fuzzy. - Image text recognition enables OCR-based search. - Configure history size, image limits, OCR, search mode. - Delete individual entries. Clear full history. - Clipboard history persists across app relaunches.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.0.0-beta.3...v1.0.0-beta.4

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.3
item.description:
## What's New - Refined first-run welcome with an animated notch greeting before onboarding. - Added Bluetooth Accessories onboarding. Connection notifications enable only after Bluetooth access is granted. - Calendar tab now enables automatically after Calendar access is granted. - Added `Check for Updates…` in About via Sparkle. - Updated onboarding branding and README roadmap.
## Improvements - Bluetooth permission no longer interrupts the welcome animation. - Improved DMG mount presentation.
## Fixes - Prevented duplicate Accessibility permission prompts during onboarding. - Fixed first-launch welcome sequencing and notch presentation. - **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.0.0-beta.2...v1.0.0-beta.3

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.2
item.description:
## What’s New
- Customizable music-control buttons. Drag actions into your preferred layout. - Added an Audio Source control with current output-device presentation. - Sneak Peek now appears for playback track changes. Timeout configurable; default: 2 seconds. - Onboarding now reopens from the menu bar and uses the notch’s transparent glass style.
## Fixes
- Fixed HUD updates after Accessibility permission is granted. - Fixed release builds that could exit before showing the menu-bar app. - Added required Bluetooth privacy disclosure. - Fixed Sparkle appcast signing key mismatch.
## Release
- Release assets now use the `anotherNotch` name. - Tagged prereleases generate Sparkle appcast entries.
> Note: Sparkle signing keys were rotated. Install this release manually once; older builds may not auto-update.
